ON THE CARD: during ask.py --build the process held 16.8 to 17.4 GB of device memory and the card ran at 86 to 98 percent SM, sampled twelve times.

CAVEAT for whoever writes the next GPU criterion: the SM column against the build process itself is empty, and that does not mean the card is idle. qrun enforces its vram cap through MPS, so a job is an MPS client, nvidia-smi pmon types it M+C and reports its SM as '-', and the utilisation appears against the nvidia-cuda-mps-server process instead. Read SM from the MPS server row and device memory from the client row, or from --query-compute-apps. A criterion that reads only the client's SM column will report a working card as idle.

ask.py now has one definition of what counts as a source, SOURCE_SUFFIXES over pdf, html, htm, txt and md, used by the manifest, the build and the digest bookkeeping alike. The INDEX.md row regex was hardcoded to .pdf too, so the zarr row had been written and silently ignored; relabel has now applied its citation. text_digest takes the source rather than a stem and hashes the extracted text where there is any, the file's own bytes where there is not, because hashing an absent text directory gave every such source the same digest and made all of them permanently unstale. 738 sources on disk, 738 digests recorded, none missing and none out of date; verified that appending a byte to the HTML file changes its digest and that restoring it changes it back.
